architectural_fidelity.reason: Same loft bedroom with sloped ceilings, identical window position and white trim, same vaulted ceiling height, same camera viewpoint from stairwell entrance, white walls preserved, door position maintained on right side.

furniture_removal.reason: Original sofa, TV console, music stand, and extensive clutter remain visible throughout the room - the render appears to have added furniture over the existing mess rather than removing it first.

style_commitment.reason: Some bohemian elements present (floor mirror, plants, layered textiles with pink/coral accents, woven basket) but lacks the conviction of maximal boho style - reads as boho-lite rather than fully committed COVABOHEMIAN aesthetic.

editorial_density.reason: Modest styling with floor lamp, mirror, several plants, layered bedding, small gallery wall, and basket - meets minimum threshold but lacks the curated vignette richness and multiple layered textiles typical of Architectural Digest bohemian spreads.

photorealism.reason: Lighting appears somewhat flat and overexposed especially on left side, material textures are acceptable but not crisp, shadows lack definition - overall reads as slightly soft/hazy rather than sharp editorial photography quality.

designer_preference_reason: Despite Collov's generic style, its superior furniture removal, cleaner execution, and professional photorealism make it more usable for client presentations than Cova's cluttered overlay approach.
what_cova_does_better: Preserves exact architectural character of the loft space
Attempts bohemian styling direction with plants and textiles
what_collov_does_better: Complete furniture removal creating clean slate
Sharp photorealistic rendering with proper lighting and shadows
Professional editorial density with layered textiles and styling details
Clean execution without remnants or ghost furniture
specific_fixes_if_failing: CRITICAL: Completely remove all original furniture before adding new elements - sofa, TV stand, music stand, and clutter are still visible
Improve lighting quality to eliminate flat overexposure on left wall
Increase bohemian style commitment with more textiles, wall hangings, macramé, patterned rugs, and layered decor
Add sharper shadow definition and material texture rendering
Increase editorial styling density with more curated surface vignettes and accessories
